title: Random Forests under Recurring Concept Drift
abstract: Random Forest ensembles remain challenging under recurring concept drift. Static ensemble voting fails when previously seen regimes return, causing slow recovery and forgetting.

sections.limitations: However, static ensemble voting fails when previously seen regimes return. Future work should reactivate useful prior experts without degrading stable-regime accuracy.

title: Failure Analysis of Online Ensembles
abstract: Online ensemble performance degrades under recurring concept drift and redundant members consume memory.

sections.discussion: The method is limited by slow post-shift recovery and does not address recurring regimes.

title: K-means with Redundant Centroids
abstract: K-means remains sensitive to initialization and redundant centroids on heterogeneous mixtures.

sections.limitations: K-means struggles with redundant centroids and varying cluster density; duplicate components reduce cluster stability.

title: Gaussian Processes in Switching Systems
abstract: Stationary Gaussian Process kernels fail when latent regimes change and the state is only partially observed.

sections.conclusion: Gaussian Process prediction degrades under regime change and remains limited by hidden-state ambiguity.

title: Redundancy and Reliability in Deep Ensembles
abstract: Deep Ensemble aggregation assumes diverse members, but correlated errors and static voting remain unresolved.

sections.future work: Future work should address ensemble redundancy through reliable aggregation without harming calibration.
